# self-update: cleanup docker images

Have `self-update docker` reclaim space as well as pull. **Motivation:** "reduce used storage space" — the attached screenshot showed Docker Desktop's disk usage dominated by unused images and dangling layers, which `update_docker` ([#2](DOT-2.md)) only adds to by pulling newer tags and leaving the old ones behind.
